# Northstar Vendor Dashboard

A multi-page vendor dashboard built with HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript, Bootstrap 5 and Font Awesome. No frontend framework or browser storage is used.

## Pages
- `index.html` — overview and sales snapshot
- `products.html` — sample catalog
- `product-form.html` — backend-ready product creation form
- `orders.html` — sample order list
- `inventory.html` — sample stock summary
- `earnings.html` — illustrative earnings/transactions
- `withdrawals.html` — withdrawal request form and history
- `settings.html` — profile settings form

Open `index.html` directly, or serve the directory using any static web server. Bootstrap and Font Awesome are loaded from CDNs, so an internet connection is required for those libraries. The custom layout and styles are in `assets/styles.css`.

All displayed business data is representative sample data. Forms contain illustrative endpoint paths only; no backend is included and no changes are persisted. Implement authentication, authorization, validation, financial computations, stock changes, and persistence in the server/database before production use.
